items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system and is actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (September 2026)
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical ones that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, other than CVE-2026-75650 which requires a separate hotfix.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (August 2026)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in these updates.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, a popular Magento full-page cache extension.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.
